# AI-Assisted Evidence Synthesis {orientation="rows"}

## Row {height="30%"}

::: {.card}
### Research focus

How can AI-assisted coding and evidence synthesis support more timely and transparent marketing decisions?
:::

::: {.card}
### Evidence source

Published marketing studies reviewed as part of the MSDM culminating experience project. This page presents the research workflow; no unverified effect-size results are displayed.
:::

## Row {height="70%"}

::: {.card}
### Meta-analysis workflow

<div class="flow-step"><strong>1. Study screening</strong><br>Identify relevant studies using predefined eligibility criteria.</div>
<div class="flow-step"><strong>2. Effect coding</strong><br>Extract reported effect measures and study characteristics.</div>
<div class="flow-step"><strong>3. Human vs. AI review</strong><br>Compare coding outputs and resolve discrepancies.</div>
<div class="flow-step"><strong>4. Synthesis</strong><br>Estimate and interpret pooled effects when eligible data are available.</div>
<div class="flow-step"><strong>5. Marketing implications</strong><br>Translate findings into evidence-based recommendations.</div>
:::

::: {.card}
### Current status

This dashboard is a **research-process overview**. It will be updated with verified project metrics, charts, and results when the final CEP dataset and findings are available.

[Read the project overview](projects/ai-meta-analysis.qmd)
:::
